note: Single readable pricing rule file. All values are bps unless stated. Starting values, to be tuned.

explain.stock_low: Stock is {pct}% below target, so the price rises {effect}%.
explain.stock_high: Stock is {pct}% above target, so the price falls {effect}%.
explain.demand_up: Recent demand is {pct}% above normal, adding {effect}%.
explain.demand_down: Recent demand is {pct}% below normal, cutting {effect}%.
explain.clamped_floor: Price held at the floor ({floor}% of base).
explain.clamped_cap: Price held at the cap ({cap}% of base).
